_meta.what: Global Premium Bundles, transcribed from the FFBE wiki's Premium Bundle page. Cash prices become Lapis at the game's own base-pack rate (serve_lapis_shop); gil and Lapis prices are kept.
_meta.kinds: contents rows are kind:id:count -- 10 unit, 20 item, 21 equipment, 23 important item, 30 gil, 50 lapis
_meta.art: Shop art from the client's own cache, files/en/sd/static_banner/bundle/ (the 600x120 promos named on the image); Early Bird's (details_banner_earlybird.png) is the 2016 Global datamine image, https://i.imgur.com/8yhkdjc.png, sha256 913efeee22a3b009dc8d9a14b29180425b9422b739c7dff30f6642cb0ff56837 (logs/reference/bundles/sources.md); Iron Chest's was not found. The list tile is a separate 200x200 icon from common_lang/sd/static_banner/bundle/ (same file name as the banner); Early Bird has none, so its `icon` is the game's own lapis chest icon; Iron Chest's is the official 2021 news icon IronChestofAbundanceUpdatedicon.png (400x400, sha256 aa9bcfee..., resized to 200x200; logs/reference/bundles/sources.md).
_meta.local_tickets: 990000107-990000112 sell the JP special summons' own ticket items (F_ITEM_MST 106213030-080) for Lapis, prices AUTHORED (Elv 2026-10-24: a local SP ticket source); 990000113 is the JP Super Premium Box (fixed bundle, 10000 Lapis, once), contents from the 2020-05 JP art (research logs/reference/jp_specials/) minus its 3 Vision Cards (no bundle reward kind for cards).
omitted: Energy rows (Early Bird has none; Iron Chest Energy x70, Bundle of Replenishment Energy x100): stamina refill is not an item the client grants
Iron Chest 'All 5-star awakening materials x20': the wiki does not name which items
Mythril/Gold/Silver Chest of Abundance: the wiki lists prices but no contents
Monthly Special and Today's Special: contents change daily on the server
Unit's Special, event daily specials and past bundles: tied to events that are not running
